Generated from `nexum --help`. Every command accepts `-c/--config` (env `NEXUM_CONFIG`, default `nexum.yaml`).

```text
Zero-trust authorization and delegated identity for AI agents

Usage: nexum [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init       Create a new organization: config, trust store, starter policy and org signing key
  gateway    
  agents     
  grants     
  trust      
  policies   
  approvals  
  audit      
  trace      
  risk       
  discover   
  call       Call a gateway's decision API as an agent (signs a fresh proof)
  eval       
  doctor     Check configuration, keys, trust, policy, state and audit integrity
  console    Local web console over this gateway's files (loopback only)
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version
```

## nexum init

```text
Create a new organization: config, trust store, starter policy and org signing key

Usage: nexum init [OPTIONS] --domain <DOMAIN>

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
      --domain <DOMAIN>  This organization's trust domain, e.g. `abc.com`
      --issuer <ISSUER>  Issuer URI for root grants. Default: https://identity.<domain>
      --dir <DIR>        [default: .]
      --listen <LISTEN>  [default: 127.0.0.1:8080]
  -h, --help             Print help
```

## nexum agents

```text
Usage: nexum agents [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  register  Register an agent. Generates a development key unless --public-key is given
  list      
  inspect   
  revoke    Revoke an agent; every grant naming it stops working immediately
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
  -h, --help             Print help
```

### nexum agents register

```text
Register an agent. Generates a development key unless --public-key is given

Usage: nexum agents register [OPTIONS] --id <ID> --name <NAME>

  -c, --config <CONFIG>            Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
      --id <ID>                    SPIFFE ID, e.g. spiffe://xyz.com/agents/procurement
      --name <NAME>                
      --owner <OWNER>              
      --description <DESCRIPTION>  
      --environment <ENVIRONMENT>  
      --framework <FRAMEWORK>      
      --endpoint <ENDPOINT>        
      --protocol <PROTOCOLS>       
      --capability <CAPABILITIES>  
      --public-key <PUBLIC_KEY>    Existing public JWK file (key stays wherever the agent keeps it)
  -h, --help                       Print help
```

## nexum grants

```text
Usage: nexum grants [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  issue     Issue a root grant signed by this organization's key
  delegate  Delegate an attenuated child grant from a grant you hold
  inspect   Decode a grant. Shows claims without verifying unless --verify
  revoke    Revoke a grant (and every grant delegated from it) by its id
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
  -h, --help             Print help
```

### nexum grants issue

```text
Issue a root grant signed by this organization's key

Usage: nexum grants issue [OPTIONS] --sub <SUB> --holder <HOLDER> --cap <CAPS> --res <RESOURCES> --aud <AUDIENCES>

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>            Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
      --sub <SUB>                  
      --holder <HOLDER>            Holder key: the agent's key file or public JWK file
      --cap <CAPS>                 
      --res <RESOURCES>            
      --aud <AUDIENCES>            Audience (receiving gateway / trust domain)
      --delegatable <DELEGATABLE>  
      --max-depth <MAX_DEPTH>      [default: 0]
      --ttl <TTL>                  Lifetime in seconds [default: 900]
      --actor <ACTOR>              Human principal this agent acts for
      --purpose <PURPOSE>          
      --max-value <MAX_VALUE>      
      --signing-key <SIGNING_KEY>  Org signing key. Default: .nexum/org.key.json next to the config
      --out <OUT>                  
  -h, --help                       Print help
```

### nexum grants delegate

```text
Delegate an attenuated child grant from a grant you hold

Usage: nexum grants delegate [OPTIONS] --parent <PARENTS> --key <KEY> --sub <SUB> --holder <HOLDER> --cap <CAPS>

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>            Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
      --parent <PARENTS>           Parent chain, root first (repeat)
      --key <KEY>                  The parent holder's private key file
      --sub <SUB>                  
      --holder <HOLDER>            
      --cap <CAPS>                 
      --res <RESOURCES>            
      --delegatable <DELEGATABLE>  
      --max-depth <MAX_DEPTH>      [default: 0]
      --ttl <TTL>                  [default: 300]
      --max-value <MAX_VALUE>      
      --out <OUT>                  
  -h, --help                       Print help
```

### nexum grants inspect

```text

Options:
```

## nexum trust

```text
Usage: nexum trust [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list        
  add         Trust another organization's root grants
  revoke      Stop accepting anything from a trust domain (takes effect immediately)
  revoke-key  Revoke a signing key: an issuer `kid`, or an agent key's JWK thumbprint. Every grant signed by or bound to it stops working
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
  -h, --help             Print help
```

## nexum policies

```text
Usage: nexum policies [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  validate  
  test      Evaluate trust + policy for a hypothetical request
  simulate  Re-evaluate recorded decisions under a proposed policy and report what would change
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
  -h, --help             Print help
```

### nexum policies validate

```text
Usage: nexum policies validate [OPTIONS] [FILE]

Arguments:
  [FILE]  

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
  -h, --help             Print help
```

### nexum policies test

```text
Evaluate trust + policy for a hypothetical request

Usage: nexum policies test [OPTIONS] --agent <AGENT> --action <ACTION> --resource <RESOURCE>

Options:
      --agent <AGENT>        Agent SPIFFE ID
  -c, --config <CONFIG>      Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
      --action <ACTION>      
      --resource <RESOURCE>  
      --value <VALUE>        
      --depth <DEPTH>        Simulated delegation depth (0 = root grant holder) [default: 0]
      --purpose <PURPOSE>    
  -h, --help                 Print help
```

### nexum policies simulate

```text
Re-evaluate recorded decisions under a proposed policy and report what would change

Usage: nexum policies simulate [OPTIONS] <PROPOSED>

Arguments:
  <PROPOSED>  The proposed policy file

Options:
      --audit <AUDITS>   Audit logs to replay (repeat). Default: this gateway's
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
      --json             
      --fail-on-widen    Exit non-zero if any decision would become more permissive
  -h, --help             Print help
```

## nexum trace

```text
Usage: nexum trace [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  inspect  Explain a decision: who acted for whom, through which delegation chain, and which check decided. Accepts a request id, decision id or trace id; a trace id gathers every hop across the given audit logs
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
  -h, --help             Print help
```

### nexum trace inspect

```text
Explain a decision: who acted for whom, through which delegation chain, and which check decided. Accepts a request id, decision id or trace id; a trace id gathers every hop across the given audit logs

Usage: nexum trace inspect [OPTIONS] <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>  

Options:
      --audit <AUDITS>   Audit logs to search (repeat for several gateways; `.jsonl` or SQLite). Default: this gateway's audit log
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
      --json             
  -h, --help             Print help
```

## nexum call

```text
Call a gateway's decision API as an agent (signs a fresh proof)

Usage: nexum call [OPTIONS] --grant <GRANTS> --key <KEY> --action <ACTION> --resource <RESOURCE>

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>      Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
      --grant <GRANTS>       Grant chain files, root first (repeat)
      --key <KEY>            The leaf holder's private key file
      --action <ACTION>      
      --resource <RESOURCE>  
      --value <VALUE>        
      --approval <APPROVAL>  
      --gateway <GATEWAY>    [default: http://127.0.0.1:8080]
      --audience <AUDIENCE>  Gateway audience. Default: the leaf grant's audience if it has one
  -h, --help                 Print help
```

## nexum eval

```text
Usage: nexum eval [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  run   Run security eval suites (and generated attacks) against sandboxed copies of this gateway's trust, policy and adapters. Exits non-zero if any scenario fails
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
  -h, --help             Print help
```

### nexum eval run

```text
Run security eval suites (and generated attacks) against sandboxed copies of this gateway's trust, policy and adapters. Exits non-zero if any scenario fails

Usage: nexum eval run [OPTIONS] [PATHS]...

Arguments:
  [PATHS]...  Suite files or directories (searched recursively) [default: evals]

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>      Path to the gateway configuration [env: NEXUM_CONFIG=] [default: nexum.yaml]
      --json                 Machine-readable results for CI
      --baseline <BASELINE>  A previous `--json` result: report scenarios that passed then and fail now (e.g. across Nexum versions or policy changes)
  -h, --help                 Print help
```
